ruppiner-seen-and-rheinsberg-castle.slogan: A 200 km loop out of Oranienburg exit fuel
ruppiner-seen-and-rheinsberg-castle.story: Water, pine forest and castle roads north of the city. 200 km round from Oranienburg - plan on about 3 h 28 of riding. sections.advice: Rheinsberg castle and lake → Neuruppin lakefront food is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

sections.advice: Neuruppin lakefront food → Kremmen moor roads is the reward section in Berlin. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-fort-krasnaya-gorka-sestroretsky-.story: A 142 km round trip from Lebyazh’ye - roughly 2 h 34 in the saddle. It goes by way of Tolbukhin Lighthouse on Tolbukhin Island, Terioki, Sestroretsky Razliv and back through Terioki. The line favours views over speed.

core-high-road-and-rio-grande-gorge-loop.story: Historic mountain villages on the outward leg and the Rio Grande corridor on the return. The road: NM-76, NM-68 and US-64. Distance and riding time are estimates from the checkpoints until the road is measured on this page.
